notes.text:
EXP_INT: U17 TCA6408A ~INT (open drain) -> U4 IO7 (R-INT-01)
  touch INT (P4) + ACC_INT (P5) stop being polled
  pull-up: ESP32 internal on GPIO7; INT holds low until
  the input port is read (SCPS192E 8.3.3), so speed is no issue
U5 BQ25628 ~INT stays NC: pin 11 is walled in by the SDA
  escape via, L1 and the SYS pour (R-INT-02); FW reads the
  latched Charger_Flag_X instead (SLUSEG4C 8.3.8.1)
IO7 wakes light sleep only, not deep sleep (R-INT-04)
